events.description: CLERK'S NOTICE: Pursuant to Local Rule 73.1(b), a United States Magistrate Judge of this court is available to conduct all proceedings in this civil action. If all parties consent to have the currently assigned United States Magistrate Judge conduct all proceedings in this case, including trial, the entry of final judgment, and all post-trial proceedings, all parties must sign their names on the attached Consent To form. This consent form is eligible for filing only if executed by all parties. The parties can also express their consent to jurisdiction by a magistrate judge in any joint filing, including the Joint Initial Status Report or proposed Case Management Order. (jcc, )

events.description: 4. MINUTE entry before the Honorable Emergency Judge Lindsay C. Jenkins: Plaintiff's motion for a preliminary injunction or a temporary restraining order 3 is entered and continued to August 8, 2024 at 10:00 a.m. in Courtroom 1419. The Court is not prepared to hold a hearing or rule on the motion until Defendants are given an opportunity to respond. In the interim, Plaintiff's counsel should promptly serve Defendants with a summons and should promptly provide Defendants with a copy of the Complaint and the motion. Plaintiff is to advise Defendants that any response to the motion should be filed within 24 hours of its receipt of the motion so that the response can be considered at the hearing. Mailed notice.
